articles.title: As search traffic dries up, Reddit announces it’s shifting to a logged-in experience
articles.description: As AI transforms how people find information online, Reddit is rethinking its open-web roots to protect its audience and business.
articles.author: Sarah Perez

articles.title: You don’t need to believe in a god to get a religious exemption from using AI at work
articles.description: David Durman, a University of Kentucky administrator, recently earned a religious exemption from using AI in the workplace.
articles.author: Amanda Silberling

articles.title: AWS will be a $1T business, Jassy says — but first, it will spend big
articles.description: Amazon wants to be the king of AI cloud computing and become the first $1 trillion revenue business. But to do that it will have to continue on its capex spending spree, its CEO said Thursday.
articles.author: Lucas Ropek

articles.title: Rivian expands joint venture with VW to include AI assistant
articles.description: Rivian doesn't disclose if the value of its $5.8 billion joint venture will expand as a result.
articles.author: Kirsten Korosec

articles.title: OpenAI-backed Thrive Holdings acquires ADT
articles.description: OpenAI-backed Thrive Holdings is buying ADT in a $15.3 billion deal, with plans to bring AI to the home security business.
articles.author: Julie Bort

articles.title: Meta quietly launches an AI fashion app called Style Sketch
articles.description: The app connects to Instagram to build a virtual closet from photos you’ve already shared, or lets you add items manually by snapping a photo, recording a quick video, or uploading images from your camera roll.
articles.author: Aisha Malik

articles.title: Granola crunches up a dictation feature to compete with Wispr
articles.description: Uno reverse! After Wispr added meeting notes to its dictation app, Granola is adding dictation to its meeting notetaker. The voice AI wars are getting interesting.
articles.author: Ivan Mehta

articles.title: Mistral releases weights for its trillion-parameter AI model, targeting cybersecurity
articles.description: Mistral says its new model can afford organizations a kind of control over its cyber defenses that closed models can't.
articles.author: Lucas Ropek

articles.title: US investigated Chinese spy plot aimed at Nvidia CEO
articles.description: A top executive of a Singapore AI cloud company that was accused of illegally selling Nvidia chips to China could also have been a Chinese spy, sources have told the New York Times.
articles.author: Julie Bort

articles.title: Ex-Palantir execs launch Dream with $17M from a16z to build AI world models for construction
articles.description: Dream is grounded in real physics and construction standards. Just as LLMs learn from text, Dream's world model is trained on more than 100 million square feet of building data gathered from permit archives across the United States.
articles.author: Marina Temkin
